notes: ὤρθριζεν takes came early in the morning whole and heads on early. Heading on morning remains defensible under rule 104's frame precedent, morning being the nominal answering to ὄρθρος, and the unit's note names that reading; early is what distinguishes the lexeme from a bare verb of motion.
ἀκούειν governs a genitive object rendered as a bare pronoun, so no case preposition arises for αὐτοῦ.
